title: two traffic fines are reviewed, authorized and paid from the wallet

provenance.stack: in-process payments, providers, gateway and operator on this machine; real local Keycloak sign-in; the issuer run clock is simulated only where a chapter says so

chapters.title: Before paying
chapters.caption: The wallet holds AED 1500.00 and the ledger has no payment yet.

chapters.title: The review
chapters.caption: Both fines, the exact total and the wallet as the source. Nothing has moved yet.
assertions: no journal entry and no hold yet
both fines still unpaid at the agency

chapters.title: Authorized
chapters.caption: The wallet holds AED 420.00 for this payment. It is reserved, not spent.

chapters.title: The receipt
chapters.caption: One payment of AED 420.00 in the ledger, the hold released, both fines paid at the agency.
